configurations.name: cs-brief-ui-sandbox
runtimeArgs: $d = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'cs-brief-sandbox'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $d | Out-Null; Copy-Item config\scoring.yaml $d -Force; Remove-Item (Join-Path $d 'settings.yaml') -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $env:CS_BRIEF_CONFIG_DIR = $d; $env:UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'cs-brief\venv'; uv run cs-brief ui --no-browser --port 8001
